sentences.en: The strength of the chain is in the weakest link.
sentences.zh: 链条的力量在于最薄弱的一环。

sentences.en: I proved the fact on the strength of the data.
sentences.zh: 我用数据证明了这一点。

sentences.en: The typhoon is gaining strength as it heads for Kyushu.
sentences.zh: 台风正增强实力，正朝九州方向移动。

phrases.zh: 有足够的力量去做某事

senses.zh: 力量,优点，长处,（光、声、色等的）力度,人力数
